pin.description: Six digits sets a new PIN; empty clears the PIN.

appBaseUrl.description:
Public base URL of the app, e.g. https://app.example.com. The callback is
`{base}/api/connections/{provider}/callback`.

text.description: One keyword per line or comma separated, max 100 per call.

tags.description: Comma separated, max 10 tags of 30 characters.

url.description: https only; the remote file is not fetched.

tags.description: Present: replace the tag list. Absent: unchanged.

mediaAlt.description: Alt text updates keyed by media id (only ids in media_ids are applied).

url.description: Optional override of the audited URL.

publicId.description: Absent keeps the stored value; empty string clears it.

secret.description: Absent or empty keeps the stored secret.

remoteIp.description: Client IP for rate limiting (set by the gateway).

StartOAuthResponseOutcome.description: - NOT_CONFIGURED: Provider app is not configured; redirect carries `?demo=1&provider=`.

memberships.description: Replaces every membership of the user.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

roas.description: Absent when no row carries a purchase value.

isNew.description: Live link first seen within the last 30 days.

referringDomains.description: Absent on days without a snapshot.

deltas.description: Present when a snapshot at least 30 days older than `latest` exists.

v1ClientAccess.description: What the caller may do with a client. Admins get role ADMIN_OVERRIDE.

providerError.description: Provider-side error query param, if any.

cookieNonce.description: Nonce read back from the cookie.

userId.description: Acting user, for the MANAGER/ADMIN check on the client in the state.

redirectUrl.description: Settings page URL with `?connected=` or `?error=` already applied.

modules.description: Channels picked in the wizard. Empty keeps the default (all modules).

lastSyncedAt.description: startedAt of the latest sync job of the module.

dataFrom.description: Earliest and latest data point inside the current range.

v1DataQuality.description: Freshness of one module for one client.

v1DataState.description: Data-quality state of one module for one client (see analytics overview).

v1DateRange.description:
Inclusive day range. Comparison periods are derived server-side
(same length, ending the day before `from`).

v1Delta.description:
Change between the current and the previous period.
`pct` is absent when the previous value is zero.

from.description: UTC bounds that were queried, [from, to).

meta.description: Non-secret state, e.g. the Meta App Review checklist.

v1KeywordIdea.description: One research idea as the provider returns it. Money in IDR.

counts.description: One entry per status, zero when empty.

followersDelta.description: Growth this period vs growth the previous period.

v1PostsTab.description: Tabs of the posts list. REJECTED sits with drafts, PUBLISHING with scheduled.

v1ProviderMode.description: Which data source answered: "dataforseo", "apify" (mock + live SERP) or "mock".

status.description: PUBLISHED, FAILED or SCHEDULED (partial, retried by the next tick).

path.description: Pages only: pathname + search of the key.

v1RangeQuery.description:
Range request as the UI sends it: a preset or a custom window.
Presets: 7d, 28d, 90d, 12m. `compare` toggles the previous-period delta.

delta.description: prev - cur; positive means the keyword moved up.

provider.description: "dataforseo", "apify" or "mock": the provider that produced the cached run.

v1ResolvedRange.description: Resolved range echoed back with every analytics response.

v1SeoDailyPoint.description: A day GSC did not report keeps clicks/impressions absent, never 0.

clients.description: Counts shown on the setup overview.

redirectUrl.description: Where to send the browser (provider consent page, or the settings page in demo mode).

nonce.description: Nonce to keep in the `{provider}_oauth_nonce` cookie. Empty when not needed.

traffic.description: Series key -> organic traffic. A missing key means no snapshot that day.

key.description: d0 (own domain), d1..d3 (top competitors by latest organic traffic).

unlockToken.description: Value for the `share_<client_id>` cookie, valid 12 hours.
